entities.name: Stephen of Liège
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stephen of Liège (also Étienne de Liège; was a Frankish churchman who was the bishop of Liège from 901 until his death in 920. He was a hagiographer and composer of church music. His surviving compositions include three Proper Offices for the Office of the Trinity, the Office of the Invention of St Stephen and the Office of St Lambert.
